title: Navier slip effects in micropolar thin-film flow: a rigorous derivation of Reynolds-type models
summary: We study the stationary flow of incompressible micropolar fluid in a thin three-dimensional domain under Navier slip boundary condition for the velocity and no-spin condition for microrotation. After rescaling the governing equations, we perform a rigorous asymptotic analysis as the film thickness tends to zero, considering a friction coefficient dependent on the small parameter. According to the scaling of the slip coefficient, we identify three distinct regimes: perfect slip, partial slip, and no-slip.
